The '''Holocron of Exar Kun''' was a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] to record his knowledge of [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Holocron of Exar Kun was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
